rationale: htop 3.5.3 uses a classic GNU Autotools build (configure.ac + Makefile.am, no generated ./configure in the tarball, only autogen.sh). prepare() runs 'autoreconf --force --install --verbose -Wall' (matching upstream autogen.sh) to generate the build system, build() runs ./configure --prefix=/usr with a set of explicit --enable-* flags, and package() does 'make DESTDIR=$pkgdir install' plus installing COPYING under /usr/share/licenses. I read configure.ac in full to enumerate every optional feature (--enable-unicode, --enable-affinity, --enable-capabilities, --enable-delayacct, --enable-sensors, --enable-hwloc, --enable-backtrace, --enable-demangling, --enable-static, --enable-pcp) and their library requirements, rather than trusting configure's 'check' auto-detection, per the guidance to avoid automagic deps. I explicitly pass --enable-unicode/--enable-affinity/--enable-capabilities/--enable-delayacct/--enable-sensors so the enabled feature set is deterministic and backed by matching depends, and I leave hwloc (alternate affinity backend, mutually exclusive with plain affinity), backtrace/libunwind (needs extra makedepends and is off by default upstream) and pcp (separate pcp-htop binary needing PCP dev libs) disabled/unrequested since they are not part of the base htop package and would need extra deps and packaging decisions out of scope for this request. No check() target exists upstream (no 'make check'/'make test'), so check() is a documented no-op rather than omitted.

dependencies.reasoning: ncurses is the hard runtime/link requirement (htop links against ncursesw for its UI, confirmed by the curses detection logic in configure.ac and the README). libcap backs --enable-capabilities (Linux capabilities support, checked via cap_init()/sys/capability.h in configure.ac). libnl backs --enable-delayacct (Linux delay accounting, requires libnl-3.0 pkg-config module and netlink/*.h headers on Arch's libnl package). lm_sensors backs --enable-sensors (sensors/sensors.h at compile time; the library itself is loaded via dlopen at runtime per upstream's own help text, but is needed at runtime for the feature to actually do anything, so it is listed as a full depends rather than optdepends to match the explicitly-enabled feature set). autoconf/automake are needed only because the tarball ships configure.ac but no generated ./configure, requiring autoreconf in prepare(); they are not omitted as base-devel members would be, but base-devel's autoconf/automake/libtool/pkgconf/gettext are assumed present per convention and not re-listed beyond the two direct autoreconf-invoking tools for clarity of intent. gcc/make/pkgconf/libtool/gettext (part of base-devel) are relied upon implicitly. hwloc, libunwind, libiberty/libdemangle, and PCP libraries are deliberately not added since their corresponding configure flags (--enable-hwloc, --with-libunwind/--enable-backtrace, --enable-demangling, --enable-pcp) are left at their safe defaults (no/off) or naturally no-op without the library present.

license.reasoning: COPYING in the source tree is the verbatim GPLv2 license text (no 'or later' clause), matching the requested license and the README's 'License: GPL v2+' badge caveat aside — the actual COPYING file text is GPLv2-only, so GPL-2.0-only is the precise SPDX identifier. The full COPYING text is installed to /usr/share/licenses/htop/ since GPL-2.0-only is not one of the license identifiers with common-license text automatically provided without installing the file.
